entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: A young tiger man of Efrava who seeks the truth about his father Jaeger and joins Adira's Circle of Seven.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: An evil wizard planning conquest, who killed Jaeger and is enslaved then freed from Shauku's prison.

entities.name: Jaeger
entities.description: Jedit's father, a tiger man killed by Johan.

entities.name: Hestia
entities.description: Jedit's friend who asks to postpone Johan's execution.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Circle of Seven who enlists Jedit.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Ally of Adira who shifts the group atop the mountains and stays behind to prepare the city.

entities.name: Circle of Seven
entities.description: Adira's mercenary band that tracks Johan.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: A vampire who lured Johan to enslave him and rule Jamuraa through the Tirras emperor.

entities.name: Akron Legionnaires
entities.description: Shauku's soldiers.

entities.name: Pinefolk
entities.description: Residents of Arboria who help the Robarans against Shauku.

entities.name: Beckoner
entities.description: Leader of the Born of the Beck tribe who saves the shipwrecked mercenaries.

entities.name: Born of the Beck
entities.description: Tribe that rescues the Robarans at sea.

entities.name: Cosmic Horror
entities.description: A creature imprisoned beneath Shauku's castle that calls down a Falling Star.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: Oasis village of the tiger tribe.

entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: City where Johan deceives Jedit and Beasts of Bogardan are summoned.

entities.name: Buzzard's Bay
entities.description: Port where Johan has a local sage killed.

entities.name: Arboria
entities.description: Pineland region containing Shauku's castle.

entities.name: Shauku's castle
entities.description: A ruined castle in Arboria, destroyed by a Falling Star.

entities.name: Prophecy of One, None, and Two
aliases: Prophecy of None, One, and Two
entities.description: Prophecy that reveals to Jedit's mother that Johan is evil.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: Johan's empire and army.

events.summary: Johan, saved by Jedit from a sand wurm, is imprisoned in Efrava; Hestia delays his execution, he escapes and Jedit follows him.
events.quote: he manages to free himself and flees the oasis, followed by Jedit

events.summary: In Palmyra Johan lies that Hazezon and Adira killed Jaeger and sends Jedit, under spells, to attack them; the spells conflict and the Robarans reveal the truth.
events.quote: permitting the Robaran Mercenaries to reveal to him that Jaeger was their good friend

events.summary: Jedit sees Jaeger's medallion on Johan and realizes Johan killed his father; Johan escapes by summoning Beasts of Bogardan and receives a vision from Shauku.
events.quote: understands that the tyrant killed his father

events.summary: Jedit joins Adira's Circle of Seven; Hazezon shifts them atop the mountains and stays behind.
events.quote: Jedit is enlisted in Adira's Circle of Seven

events.summary: Johan learns Shauku's castle location from a sage in Buzzard's Bay and has the sage killed.
The Robarans are cleared of the sage's murder, attacked by Johan's corsairs and shipwrecked, then saved by Beckoner and the Born of the Beck.
events.quote: They are saved by Beckoner and the Born of the Beck tribe

events.summary: Shauku enchants Johan, reveals herself as a vampire and traps him in amber near the Cosmic Horror.
events.quote: Johan is then trapped in an amber prison near the horror.

events.summary: The Robarans infiltrate Shauku's castle; Adira frees Johan, Jedit incapacitates Shauku, and they escape as the Falling Star destroys the castle.
The survivors prepare to return home to stop Johan's conquest.
events.quote: prepare to return home and stop Johan's plan of conquest

relations.note: Jedit realizes Johan killed his father
relations.quote: understands that the tyrant killed his father
a young tiger man who has awaited his father, Jaeger
casts a command enchantment on Johan, binding the wizard to her will
